The '''Skirmish on Holageus''' was a battle of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Holageus]].

==The battle==
Holageus was the site of a vicious battle between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces and the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> The two [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] brothers [[Tokkat/Legends|Tokkat]] and [[Wunka/Legends|Wunka]] fought for the New Republic during this battle but Wunka was killed.<ref name="GatORW" />

==Aftermath==
Following the battle, Tokkat took the body of his brother back to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] for burial. Rather than returning to combat, he then retired on the Forest Moon. As an honored hunter of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], he served as its unofficial ambassador to the New Republic.<ref name="GatORW" />
